entries.name: Technology Stack Policy
entries.description: Enforces project-declared tech stack boundaries and prevents casual introduction of unapproved frameworks.

entries.name: Version Constraint Policy
entries.description: Enforces version policy rules (current-stable, project-compatible, pinned) over raw 'latest'.

entries.name: Documentation Freshness Policy
entries.description: TRAINING KNOWLEDGE ≠ SOURCE OF TRUTH. Forces agents to verify current official documentation over model training memory.

entries.name: Security & Secret Management Policy
entries.description: Enforces zero-secret leakage, input validation at boundaries, and parameterized database queries.

entries.name: Modular Architecture Policy
entries.description: Enforces clean separation of concerns, public contract boundaries, and small composable units.

entries.name: Insecure API Sinks
entries.description: Blocks dangerous API calls that create injection, XSS, or transport-security holes — eval, raw DOM HTML injection, TLS verification bypass, shell string execution, weak crypto on credentials.

entries.name: Dependency Boundary Policy
entries.description: Restricts unapproved external package additions.

entries.name: God File Limit
entries.description: Flags oversized files that accumulate too many responsibilities — "god files" that violate single-responsibility and become unmaintainable.

entries.name: Sensitive File Guard
entries.description: Blocks scanning/working on committed sensitive files — env files, private keys, certificates, and credential stores must never live in the source tree.

entries.name: Coding Standards Policy
entries.description: Requires strict linting, formatting, type checking, and test verification before completion.

entries.name: Deprecated Package Guard
entries.description: Flags dependencies that are deprecated, renamed, abandoned, or carry known vulnerabilities — checked against the built-in advisory database in every manifest the scanner finds.

entries.name: Domain-Driven Layout
entries.description: Enforces domain-driven project structure — source files must be grouped by domain/bounded context, not dumped flat into a single directory.

entries.name: Debug Statement Hygiene
entries.description: Flags debugging statements left in source — console.log, debugger, pdb breakpoints, and print-debugging should not ship.

entries.name: Deferred Work Hygiene
entries.description: Tracks TODO/FIXME/HACK accumulation — a file drowning in deferred-work markers signals unfinished or unstable code.

entries.name: Dependency Freshness
entries.description: Flags outdated dependencies by shelling out to the ecosystem package manager (npm outdated, go list -m -u) when the toolchain is installed and the registry is reachable.

entries.name: accessibility
entries.description: Enforces WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, and semantic HTML.
